chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from ʿUthmān ibn ʿĪsā, from Samāʿah, from Abū ʿAbdillāh (عليه السلام), who said:
I heard him saying: “What is the matter with you, that you offend the Messenger of Allah (صلى الله عليه وآله)?”
Then a man said, “How do we offend him?” So he said, “Do you not know that your deeds are presented to him? Then when he sees in them an act of disobedience, that grieves him.”
So do not offend the Messenger of Allah; rather, bring him joy.”

key_terms.رَسُولَ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah, Muḥammad (صلى الله عليه وآله)
key_terms.مَعْصِيَةً: an act of disobedience or sin

ai.seo_question: How do a believer’s deeds affect the Messenger of Allah (صلى الله عليه وآله) according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that the deeds of the believers are presented to the Messenger of Allah (صلى الله عليه وآله), and their sins cause him grief. It exhorts the believers to avoid disobedience and to act in ways that please him. The narration emphasizes moral accountability and the living spiritual bond between the Ummah and the Prophet (صلى الله عليه وآله).

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Usman Bin Isa, from Sama’at, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I heard him<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘What is the matter with you all, upsetting Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>?’
So the man said, ‘How are we upsetting him<sup>saww</sup>?’

So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘But, are you not knowing that your deeds are presented to him<sup>saww</sup>? So when he<sup>saww</sup> sees your deeds wherein is disobedience, that upsets him<sup>saww</sup>.
So do not upset Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> and (instead) cheer him<sup>saww</sup> up’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ‘Uthman ibn ’Isa from Suma‘ who has said that he heard abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) say the following.
“What is wrong with you? Why do you disappoint the Messenger of Allah?”
A man asked, “How do we disappoint him?” The Imams (a.s.) said, “Do you not know that your deeds are presented before him? When he find sins in them it disappoints him.
Do not disappoint the Messenger of Allah. Do things that will make him happy.”
